kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-security-proxy --proxy-name nat-firewall --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id 'vpc-uf6b5lyul0x******' --nat-gateway-id 'ngw-bp1okz6k7******' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityProxy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAT firewall. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). It cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh: NAT防火墙名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为4~50个字符，且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: proxy_name

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC
parameters.help_zh: VPC实例ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh: NAT网关的ID。
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the automatic mode for the vSwitch. Valid values:

true: automatic mode.
false: manual mode.

Default value: true. If VswitchAuto is set to true, VswitchCidr is required and must be a valid CIDR block. If VswitchAuto is set to false, VswitchId is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用交换机自动模式。取值：
true：自动模式
false：手动模式
VswitchAuto 默认 true。VswitchAuto=true 时 VswitchCidr 必填（且须为合法 CIDR）；VswitchAuto=false 时 VswitchId 必填
parameters.name: vswitch_auto

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when the manual mode is used for the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。交换机手动模式时必填
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The architecture type of the NAT firewall. Valid values: eni (traditional ENI architecture) and gwlb (new GWLB architecture). If this parameter is omitted or left empty, the firewall is created by using the ENI architecture, and no implicit selection is performed on the server side. You can obtain the recommended architecture from the response of the DescribeNatFirewallArchitecture operation and pass it back when you create the firewall
parameters.help_zh: NAT 防火墙架构类型。eni：传统 ENI 架构；gwlb：GWLB 新架构。省略或空串按 eni 创建，不做服务端隐式选型；推荐架构可通过 DescribeNatFirewallArchitecture 的返回结果获取并在创建时回传
parameters.name: nat_mode

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the default route
fields.name: destination_cidr

fields.help_en: The next hop ID of the original NAT gateway
fields.name: next_hop_id

fields.help_en: The network type of the next hop. Valid values: NatGateway
fields.help_zh: 下一跳的网络类型。取值：NatGateway
fields.name: next_hop_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the route table to which the default route of the NAT gateway belongs
fields.help_zh: NAT网关默认路由所在路由表
fields.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The list of routes to be switched for the NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh: NAT网关待切换路由列表
parameters.name: nat_route_entry_list

parameters.help_en:
The security protection switch. Valid values:

open: enabled.
close: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
安全防护开关。取值：
open：打开
close：关闭
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable strict mode. Valid values:

1: enables strict mode.
0: disables strict mode
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用严格模式

1：启用严格模式
0：禁用严格模式
parameters.name: strict_mode

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when the automatic mode is used for the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的网段。交换机自动模式时必填
parameters.name: vswitch_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode of the firewall service. Valid values:

PrimaryStandby: primary/secondary mode.
MultiPrimary: active-active mode
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙服务部署模式。取值：

PrimaryStandby：主备模式
MultiPrimary：双活模式
parameters.name: firewall_service_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of zone IDs used by the firewall service
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙服务使用的可用区 ID 列表
parameters.name: firewall_service_zones

parameters.help_en: The zone of the firewall vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙交换机可用区
parameters.name: fw_vswitch_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the primary zone. This parameter applies only to NAT firewalls that use the GWLB architecture. For the GWLB architecture, this parameter is required along with MasterVSwitchCidr, StandbyZoneId, and StandbyVSwitchCidr. If any of these parameters is missing, ErrorParameters is returned. The value must be the same as the zone where the NAT gateway resides. This parameter is not read for the ENI architecture
parameters.help_zh: 主可用区 ID。仅 GWLB 架构的 NAT 防火墙适用，该架构下与 MasterVSwitchCidr、StandbyZoneId、StandbyVSwitchCidr 四参缺一不可，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters；取值必须与 NAT 网关所在可用区一致。ENI 架构不读取本参数
parameters.name: master_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch CIDR block of the GWLB endpoint (GWLBe) in the active zone. This parameter applies only to NAT firewalls that use the GWLB architecture. For the GWLB architecture, this parameter is required along with MasterZoneId, StandbyZoneId, and StandbyVSwitchCidr. If any of these parameters is missing, ErrorParameters is returned. The vSwitch is created by the firewall creation node based on this vSwitch CIDR block. This parameter is not read for the ENI architecture
parameters.help_zh: 主可用区 gwlbe 交换机网段。仅 GWLB 架构的 NAT 防火墙适用，该架构下与 MasterZoneId、StandbyZoneId、StandbyVSwitchCidr 四参缺一不可，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters；交换机由开墙任务按该网段现建。ENI 架构不读取本参数
parameters.name: master_vswitch_cidr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the secondary zone. This parameter applies only to NAT firewalls that use the GWLB architecture. For the GWLB architecture, this parameter is required along with MasterZoneId, MasterVSwitchCidr, and StandbyVSwitchCidr. If any of these parameters is missing, ErrorParameters is returned. The value cannot be the same as MasterZoneId. If they are the same, ErrorZoneIdInvalid is returned. This parameter is not read for the ENI architecture
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区 ID。仅 GWLB 架构的 NAT 防火墙适用，该架构下与 MasterZoneId、MasterVSwitchCidr、StandbyVSwitchCidr 四参缺一不可，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters；不得与 MasterZoneId 相同，相同时返回 ErrorZoneIdInvalid。ENI 架构不读取本参数
parameters.name: standby_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch CIDR block of the GWLBe in the standby zone. This parameter applies only to NAT firewalls that use the GWLB architecture. For the GWLB architecture, this parameter is required along with MasterZoneId, MasterVSwitchCidr, and StandbyZoneId. If any of these parameters is missing, ErrorParameters is returned. The vSwitch is created by the firewall creation node based on this vSwitch CIDR block. This parameter is not read for the ENI architecture
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区 gwlbe 交换机网段。仅 GWLB 架构的 NAT 防火墙适用，该架构下与 MasterZoneId、MasterVSwitchCidr、StandbyZoneId 四参缺一不可，缺失时返回 ErrorParameters；交换机由开墙任务按该网段现建。ENI 架构不读取本参数
parameters.name: standby_vswitch_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The IPS defense mode. This parameter is supported only by NAT firewalls that use the GWLB architecture. If this parameter is not specified, the system default (Block Mode) is used. Valid values:

0: monitor mode. Only alerting is triggered, and traffic is not blocked.
1: Block Mode
parameters.help_zh:
IPS 防护模式，仅 GWLB 架构的 NAT 防火墙支持。不传则沿用系统默认（拦截模式）。取值：
0：观察模式，仅告警不拦截。
1：拦截模式
parameters.name: run_mode

parameters.help_en:
The level of the IPS rule group. This parameter is valid only in block mode. If this parameter is not specified, the system default (medium) is used. Valid values:

0: none. The value is forced to 0 in monitor mode.
1: loose.
2: medium.
3: strict
parameters.help_zh:
IPS 规则组等级，仅拦截模式下有意义。不传则沿用系统默认（中等）。取值：
0：无，观察模式下被强制归零。
1：宽松。
2：中等。
3：严格
parameters.name: rule_class

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the basic protection policies of the IPS. If this parameter is not specified, the system default (enabled) is used. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
IPS 基础防御规则开关，不传则沿用系统默认（开启）。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
parameters.name: basic_defense_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Virtual Patches of the IPS. If this parameter is not specified, the system default (enabled) is used. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
IPS 虚拟补丁规则开关，不传则沿用系统默认（开启）。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
parameters.name: virtual_patch_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the threat intelligence rules of the IPS. If this parameter is not specified, the system default (enabled) is used. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
IPS 威胁情报规则开关，不传则沿用系统默认（开启）。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
parameters.name: threat_intel_enabled

ProxyId.description_en: The ID of the NAT firewall
